notes.note: Scoped #3994(a) delta review: checked relevant terminal, scope, preset, capability and historical references against environment-security, pairing-route-scopes, station-groups and NodePtyAdapter. Observe remains explicit promotion, presets/defaults are unchanged, operate implies observe only at admission, and child-status census runs only during journal backpressure. Legacy listeners, broker/native admission, engine sign-in, configuration and release contracts keep their existing owners. No prose change is needed for these unaffected claims. This is no new remote, native or release qualification.

Reviewed the #3994(a) personal-operator session boundary and bounded journal against TerminalSessions, TerminalJournal, NodePtyAdapter and production route composition. The POSIX adapter observes E/Z or unavailable child census while paused, resumes and carries output uncertainty into failed/unavailable session status. Reviewed decrement-before-promise-settlement ordering, observe group governance, unchanged presets and 236/256 scope length. Focused session/adapter tests passed; four clean-tree faults caught exit-status, child-observation, final-batch decrement and group-ceiling regressions with restored green runs. Earlier uncaught timing probes are diagnostic failures. Windows, remote/native, supervisor and release behavior remain unqualified.
